package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"math"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

var (
	ErrInvalidStudentContext   = errors.New("invalid student context")
	ErrStudentContextNotFound  = errors.New("student context not found")
	ErrStudentStateUnavailable = errors.New("student state unavailable")
	ErrLearningActionClosed    = errors.New("learning action is closed")
)

const StudentLearnerOverviewVersion = "student-learner-overview-v2"

const StudentLearningActionCodeContextVersion = "student-learning-action-code-context-v1"

const SandboxValidationObservationVersion = "sandbox-validation-observation-v1"

// LearningActionStatus is the Student-owned action lifecycle projection.
type LearningActionStatus string

const (
	LearningActionStatusOpen   LearningActionStatus = "OPEN"
	LearningActionStatusClosed LearningActionStatus = "CLOSED"
)

// TargetMasteryState is read from Student and never mutated by Teacher.
type TargetMasteryState string

const (
	TargetMasteryUnknown    TargetMasteryState = "UNKNOWN"
	TargetMasteryExposed    TargetMasteryState = "EXPOSED"
	TargetMasteryUnderstood TargetMasteryState = "UNDERSTOOD"
	TargetMasteryPracticed  TargetMasteryState = "PRACTICED"
	TargetMasteryApplied    TargetMasteryState = "APPLIED"
	TargetMasteryMastered   TargetMasteryState = "MASTERED"
)

// StudentLearningActionSnapshot is a bounded Student-owned fact projection.
// It contains no answer identity, outcome, evidence rows, or mastery audit.
type StudentLearningActionSnapshot struct {
	LearningActionID string
	StudentID        string
	TaskID           string
	ContextType      LearningContextType
	ContextID        string
	LearningTargets  []LearningTargetRef
	Status           LearningActionStatus
	OpenedAt         time.Time
}

type StudentCodeFile struct {
	Path      string `json:"path"`
	Content   string `json:"content"`
	Truncated bool   `json:"truncated"`
}

type StudentValidationObservation struct {
	Available     bool       `json:"available"`
	Kind          string     `json:"kind"`
	Passed        bool       `json:"passed"`
	IssueCount    int        `json:"issue_count"`
	CheckedAt     *time.Time `json:"checked_at,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion string     `json:"policy_version"`
}

// StudentLearningActionCodeContext is a bounded Student-sanitized workspace
// projection. It contains no answer/Sandbox identity or validator output.
type StudentLearningActionCodeContext struct {
	LearningActionID string                       `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID        string                       `json:"student_id"`
	TaskID           string                       `json:"task_id"`
	Available        bool                         `json:"available"`
	Files            []StudentCodeFile            `json:"files"`
	OmittedFileCount int                          `json:"omitted_file_count"`
	Truncated        bool                         `json:"truncated"`
	PolicyVersion    string                       `json:"policy_version"`
	Validation       StudentValidationObservation `json:"validation"`
}

// StudentTargetMastery is one current projection for an exact target.
type StudentTargetMastery struct {
	Target                  LearningTargetRef
	State                   TargetMasteryState
	MasteryScore            float64
	Confidence              float64
	IndependentSuccessCount int
	AssistedSuccessCount    int
	FailureCount            int
	EvidenceCount           int
	LastSeenAt              *time.Time
	LastPracticedAt         *time.Time
	LastFailedAt            *time.Time
	PolicyVersion           string
}

// StudentOnboardingSnapshot is declared preference data, not diagnosed level
// or mastery evidence.
type StudentOnboardingSnapshot struct {
	DirectionCode          string   `json:"direction_code"`
	SelfAssessedExperience string   `json:"self_assessed_experience"`
	KnownStacks            []string `json:"known_stacks"`
	DesiredStacks          []string `json:"desired_stacks"`
	GoalCode               string   `json:"goal_code"`
	GoalText               string   `json:"goal_text,omitempty"`
	PreferredLanguage      string   `json:"preferred_language"`
	WeeklyMinutes          int      `json:"weekly_minutes"`
	PreferredPace          string   `json:"preferred_pace"`
	ProfileVersion         string   `json:"profile_version"`
	Version                int64    `json:"version"`
}

// StudentLearnerOverview is the bounded Student-owned projection used only for
// general teacher dialogs.
type StudentLearnerOverview struct {
	StudentID      string
	Version        string
	Onboarding     *StudentOnboardingSnapshot
	RecentMastery  []StudentTargetMastery
	LearningPath   *StudentLearningPath
	Diagnostic     *StudentDiagnosticSnapshot
	RecentSessions []StudentLearningSession
}

// StudentContext is an in-memory request snapshot for deterministic teacher
// policy and later model orchestration. It is never persisted as student state.
type StudentContext struct {
	StudentID          string
	LearningActionID   string
	TaskID             string
	ContextType        LearningContextType
	ContextID          string
	LearningTargets    []LearningTargetRef
	RelevantMastery    []StudentTargetMastery
	Onboarding         *StudentOnboardingSnapshot
	LearningPath       *StudentLearningPath
	Diagnostic         *StudentDiagnosticSnapshot
	RecentSessions     []StudentLearningSession
	CodeContext        *StudentLearningActionCodeContext
	PracticeTask       *PracticeTaskContext
	PracticeValidation *PracticeTeacherValidationContext
}

func NewGeneralStudentContext(overview StudentLearnerOverview) (StudentContext, error) {
	overview.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(overview.StudentID)
	overview.Version = strings.TrimSpace(overview.Version)
	if !validUUID(overview.StudentID) || overview.Version != StudentLearnerOverviewVersion || len(overview.RecentMastery) > 20 {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	var onboarding *StudentOnboardingSnapshot
	if overview.Onboarding != nil {
		normalized, normalizeErr := NormalizeStudentOnboardingSnapshot(*overview.Onboarding)
		if normalizeErr != nil {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		onboarding = &normalized
	}
	mastery := make([]StudentTargetMastery, len(overview.RecentMastery))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(mastery))
	for index, item := range overview.RecentMastery {
		targets, err := normalizeLearningTargetRefs([]LearningTargetRef{item.Target}, 1)
		if err != nil || !validTargetMastery(item) || item.State == TargetMasteryUnknown {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		identity := targetIdentity(targets[0])
		if _, exists := seen[identity]; exists {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		seen[identity] = struct{}{}
		item.Target = targets[0]
		item.LastSeenAt = utcTimePointer(item.LastSeenAt)
		item.LastPracticedAt = utcTimePointer(item.LastPracticedAt)
		item.LastFailedAt = utcTimePointer(item.LastFailedAt)
		mastery[index] = item
	}
	var path *StudentLearningPath
	if overview.LearningPath != nil {
		normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningPath(*overview.LearningPath, overview.StudentID)
		if err != nil {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		path = &normalized
	}
	var diagnostic *StudentDiagnosticSnapshot
	if overview.Diagnostic != nil {
		normalized, err := NormalizeStudentDiagnosticSnapshot(*overview.Diagnostic, overview.StudentID)
		if err != nil {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		diagnostic = &normalized
	}
	sessions, err := NormalizeStudentLearningSessions(overview.RecentSessions, overview.StudentID)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	return StudentContext{
		StudentID: overview.StudentID, ContextType: LearningContextGeneral,
		RelevantMastery: mastery, Onboarding: onboarding, LearningPath: path,
		Diagnostic: diagnostic, RecentSessions: sessions,
	}, nil
}

// NormalizeStudentOnboardingSnapshot validates the authoritative profile
// without consulting the learner-overview legacy diagnostic field. The latter
// is compatibility history and is never official completion proof.
func NormalizeStudentOnboardingSnapshot(input StudentOnboardingSnapshot) (StudentOnboardingSnapshot, error) {
	input.DirectionCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.DirectionCode))
	input.SelfAssessedExperience = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.SelfAssessedExperience))
	input.GoalCode = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalCode))
	input.GoalText = strings.TrimSpace(input.GoalText)
	input.PreferredLanguage = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.PreferredLanguage))
	input.PreferredPace = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.PreferredPace))
	input.ProfileVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.ProfileVersion)
	known, knownErr := normalizeProfileValues(input.KnownStacks)
	desired, desiredErr := normalizeProfileValues(input.DesiredStacks)
	if knownErr != nil || desiredErr != nil || len(desired) == 0 ||
		!validValue(input.DirectionCode, 64) || !validValue(input.SelfAssessedExperience, 64) ||
		!validValue(input.GoalCode, 64) || len(input.GoalText) > 2000 ||
		!validValue(input.PreferredLanguage, 16) || !validValue(input.PreferredPace, 64) ||
		input.ProfileVersion != "student-onboarding-v1" || input.Version < 1 ||
		input.WeeklyMinutes < 15 || input.WeeklyMinutes > 10080 {
		return StudentOnboardingSnapshot{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	input.KnownStacks = known
	input.DesiredStacks = desired
	return input, nil
}

func NewLessonStudentContext(overview StudentLearnerOverview, lessonID string) (StudentContext, error) {
	contextValue, err := NewGeneralStudentContext(overview)
	lessonID = strings.TrimSpace(lessonID)
	if err != nil || !validUUID(lessonID) {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	contextValue.ContextType = LearningContextLesson
	contextValue.ContextID = lessonID
	return contextValue, nil
}

func normalizeProfileValues(values []string) ([]string, error) {
	if len(values) > 20 {
		return nil, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
	for _, value := range values {
		value = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value))
		if !validValue(value, 64) {
			return nil, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		if _, exists := seen[value]; exists {
			continue
		}
		seen[value] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, nil
}

// NormalizeStudentLearningActionSnapshot validates the trusted action identity
// before any mastery query is issued.
func NormalizeStudentLearningActionSnapshot(input StudentLearningActionSnapshot) (StudentLearningActionSnapshot, error) {
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.OpenedAt = input.OpenedAt.UTC()
	if !validUUID(input.LearningActionID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.TaskID) ||
		!validClosedActionContextType(input.ContextType) || !validUUID(input.ContextID) || input.OpenedAt.IsZero() ||
		(input.Status != LearningActionStatusOpen && input.Status != LearningActionStatusClosed) {
		return StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	targets, err := normalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.LearningTargets, 100)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentLearningActionSnapshot{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	input.LearningTargets = targets
	return input, nil
}

func NormalizeStudentLearningActionCodeContext(input StudentLearningActionCodeContext, studentID, learningActionID, taskID string) (StudentLearningActionCodeContext, error) {
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.Validation.Kind = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Validation.Kind))
	input.Validation.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.Validation.PolicyVersion)
	if input.Validation.CheckedAt != nil {
		checkedAt := input.Validation.CheckedAt.UTC()
		input.Validation.CheckedAt = &checkedAt
	}
	if input.StudentID != strings.TrimSpace(studentID) || input.LearningActionID != strings.TrimSpace(learningActionID) ||
		input.TaskID != strings.TrimSpace(taskID) || !validUUID(input.StudentID) || !validUUID(input.LearningActionID) ||
		!validUUID(input.TaskID) || input.PolicyVersion != StudentLearningActionCodeContextVersion || len(input.Files) > 12 ||
		input.Validation.PolicyVersion != SandboxValidationObservationVersion || !validStudentValidationObservation(input.Validation) ||
		input.OmittedFileCount < 0 || input.OmittedFileCount > 100_000 || (!input.Available && (len(input.Files) != 0 || input.OmittedFileCount != 0 || input.Truncated || input.Validation.Available)) {
		return StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	files := make([]StudentCodeFile, len(input.Files))
	seen, totalBytes, anyFileTruncated := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Files)), 0, false
	for index, file := range input.Files {
		file.Path = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(file.Path, "\\", "/"))
		if file.Path == "" || len(file.Path) > 300 || strings.HasPrefix(file.Path, "/") ||
			strings.Contains("/"+file.Path+"/", "/../") || strings.ContainsRune(file.Path, '\x00') ||
			!utf8.ValidString(file.Path) || !utf8.ValidString(file.Content) || strings.ContainsRune(file.Content, '\x00') ||
			len(file.Content) > 16<<10 {
			return StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
			return StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
		totalBytes += len(file.Content)
		anyFileTruncated = anyFileTruncated || file.Truncated
		files[index] = file
	}
	if totalBytes > 64<<10 || input.Truncated != (input.OmittedFileCount > 0 || anyFileTruncated) {
		return StudentLearningActionCodeContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	input.Files = files
	return input, nil
}

func validStudentValidationObservation(input StudentValidationObservation) bool {
	if input.IssueCount < 0 || input.IssueCount > 10_000 {
		return false
	}
	if !input.Available {
		return input.Kind == "" && !input.Passed && input.IssueCount == 0 && input.CheckedAt == nil
	}
	return (input.Kind == "validation" || input.Kind == "tests") && input.CheckedAt != nil && !input.CheckedAt.IsZero()
}

func WithStudentCodeContext(contextValue StudentContext, input StudentLearningActionCodeContext) (StudentContext, error) {
	if contextValue.ContextType == LearningContextGeneral || contextValue.ContextType == LearningContextLesson ||
		contextValue.LearningActionID == "" || contextValue.TaskID == "" {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningActionCodeContext(
		input, contextValue.StudentID, contextValue.LearningActionID, contextValue.TaskID,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentContext{}, err
	}
	contextValue.CodeContext = &normalized
	return contextValue, nil
}

// NewStudentContext validates the exact ordered mastery response against the
// frozen target snapshot and returns defensive copies.
func NewStudentContext(
	snapshot StudentLearningActionSnapshot,
	mastery []StudentTargetMastery,
) (StudentContext, error) {
	normalized, err := NormalizeStudentLearningActionSnapshot(snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentContext{}, err
	}
	if normalized.Status != LearningActionStatusOpen {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrLearningActionClosed
	}
	if len(mastery) != len(normalized.LearningTargets) {
		return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
	}
	normalizedMastery := make([]StudentTargetMastery, len(mastery))
	for index, item := range mastery {
		targets, targetErr := normalizeLearningTargetRefs([]LearningTargetRef{item.Target}, 1)
		if targetErr != nil || targetIdentity(targets[0]) != targetIdentity(normalized.LearningTargets[index]) ||
			!validTargetMastery(item) {
			return StudentContext{}, ErrInvalidStudentContext
		}
		item.Target = targets[0]
		item.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(item.PolicyVersion)
		item.LastSeenAt = utcTimePointer(item.LastSeenAt)
		item.LastPracticedAt = utcTimePointer(item.LastPracticedAt)
		item.LastFailedAt = utcTimePointer(item.LastFailedAt)
		normalizedMastery[index] = item
	}
	return StudentContext{
		StudentID:        normalized.StudentID,
		LearningActionID: normalized.LearningActionID,
		TaskID:           normalized.TaskID,
		ContextType:      normalized.ContextType,
		ContextID:        normalized.ContextID,
		LearningTargets:  append([]LearningTargetRef(nil), normalized.LearningTargets...),
		RelevantMastery:  normalizedMastery,
	}, nil
}

func validTargetMastery(item StudentTargetMastery) bool {
	if !validTargetMasteryState(item.State) || !validValue(strings.TrimSpace(item.PolicyVersion), 64) ||
		item.MasteryScore < 0 || item.MasteryScore > 1 || math.IsNaN(item.MasteryScore) || math.IsInf(item.MasteryScore, 0) ||
		item.Confidence < 0 || item.Confidence > 1 || math.IsNaN(item.Confidence) || math.IsInf(item.Confidence, 0) ||
		item.IndependentSuccessCount < 0 || item.AssistedSuccessCount < 0 || item.FailureCount < 0 || item.EvidenceCount < 0 ||
		item.IndependentSuccessCount+item.AssistedSuccessCount+item.FailureCount != item.EvidenceCount {
		return false
	}
	if item.State == TargetMasteryUnknown {
		return item.EvidenceCount == 0 && item.MasteryScore == 0 && item.Confidence == 0 &&
			item.LastSeenAt == nil && item.LastPracticedAt == nil && item.LastFailedAt == nil
	}
	return item.EvidenceCount > 0 && item.LastSeenAt != nil && !item.LastSeenAt.IsZero()
}

func validTargetMasteryState(value TargetMasteryState) bool {
	switch value {
	case TargetMasteryUnknown, TargetMasteryExposed, TargetMasteryUnderstood,
		TargetMasteryPracticed, TargetMasteryApplied, TargetMasteryMastered:
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func targetIdentity(target LearningTargetRef) string {
	return string(target.Type) + "\x00" + target.Key + "\x00" + target.Version
}

func utcTimePointer(value *time.Time) *time.Time {
	if value == nil {
		return nil
	}
	normalized := value.UTC()
	return &normalized
}
